::: {#fig-check-series-rc layout-nrow=2}

```{python}
#| label: fig-check-series-rc-before
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Original: the internal node stores charge and the resistor dissipates energy."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=15)
    elm.Dot().at((0, 0)).label('A', loc='left')
    elm.Resistor().right().label(r'$R_1=100\,\Omega$')
    elm.Dot().label('n', loc='bottom')
    elm.Capacitor().right().label(r'$C_1=1\,\mathrm{pF}$')
    elm.Dot().label('B', loc='right')
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-check-series-rc-after
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Aggressive reduction: the capacitor remains, but its series loss disappears."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

def strike_through(drawing: sd.Drawing, element: elm.Element):
    x, y = element.center
    drawing.add(elm.Line().at((x-0.35, y-0.35)).to((x+0.35, y+0.35)).color('red').linewidth(2))

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=15)
    elm.Dot().at((0, 0)).label('A', loc='left')
    resistor=elm.Resistor().right().label(r'$R_1$')
    elm.Dot().label('n', loc='bottom')
    capacitor=elm.Capacitor().right().label(r'$C_1$')
    elm.Dot().label('B', loc='right')
    strike_through(d, resistor)
    strike_through(d, capacitor)
    elm.Line().at((0, 0)).down().length(1.6).color('green')
    elm.Capacitor().right().length(6).label(r'$C_{\mathrm{red}}=1\,\mathrm{pF}$', loc='bottom').color('green')
    elm.Line().up().length(1.6).color('green')
```

`A` ↔ `B` before and after eliminating `n`. Red strokes mark removed elements, and green marks the new element.

:::
